primitives.name: Pleasure-Pain Teleology
primitives.verbatim_quote: It might be that to reflection such a narrow teleology would justify itself, that pleasures and pains might seem the only comprehensible and reasonable motives for action, the only motives on which we ought to act.
primitives.assumptions: Ethical teleology assumes rationality and self-interest; pleasure-pain is a sufficient but not necessary condition for action.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ethical frameworks fail to predict behavior due to non-rational or unconscious motivators.

layer2.mapping: Maps ethical propositions into probabilistic action kernels within GSI’s Bayesian inference framework.
layer2.telemetry: Behavioral consistency under moral framing vs. actual action outcomes.

primitives.name: Emotional Instinctual Motivation
primitives.verbatim_quote: These motives are supplied by innumerable objects, which innervate our voluntary muscles by a process as automatic as that by which they light a fever in our breasts.
primitives.assumptions: Motivational processes are driven by automatic neural feedback rather than conscious deliberation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When conscious control fails to override innate response patterns.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphically maps emotional states to motoric outputs in GSE's state transition graph.
layer2.telemetry: Neuroimaging correlates between emotional arousal and motoric readiness.

primitives.name: Parental Affection Instantiation
primitives.verbatim_quote: It seems to me that there must be at the [parental instinct's] foundation that intense pleasure in the embrace of the young which we find to characterize the parental feeling throughout.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{parent}': 'parental affection index (dimensionless)', 'F_{young}': "young's physical presence (SI: m³)", 'U_{pleasure}': 'pleasure utility (SI: J)'}
primitives.assumptions: Affectional bonds form through pleasurable sensory integration and are reinforced by habituation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When parental motivation decouples from immediate sensory reward.

layer2.mapping: Encodes parental drive as a derived kernel in GSI's affective state model.
layer2.telemetry: Cross-modal sensory engagement during caregiving behaviors.

The failure mode occurs when ethical frameworks assume rationality while ignoring the automatic nature of instinctual drives. Dualities emerge between conscious choice and unconscious compulsion, with pleasure-pain teleology representing a normative dualism and emotional-instinctual motivation embodying a mechanistic one. The epistemic gap lies in bridging subjective experience with objective behavioral prediction—a challenge resolved through Bayesian inference in GSI and stochastic modeling in GSE.
